def forward(self, x):
    shortcut = x
    out = self.conv_1(x)
    out = self.conv_1_bn(out)
    out = F.relu(out)
    out = self.conv_2(out)
    out = self.conv_2_bn(out)
    shortcut = self.conv_shortcut_1(shortcut)
    shortcut = self.conv_shortcut_1_bn(shortcut)
    out += shortcut
    out = F.relu(out)
    return out
